answer: When k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus event, correlated-evidence penalties aggregate across identity pairs, producing O(k^2) slashing rather than k independent linear fines. Bonded escrows make each identity’s stake collectible; repeated detection compounds asymmetric capital depreciation, so maintaining a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in total capital loss. A jetty of aliases cannot hide the mirror of shared behavior, and surviving stake is a relic, not a reset.
